title: Tadpole Elixir
summary: Illithid powers grant 3 rounds of Advantage on attacks at the cost of weaker mental and Constitution saves.

fields.Drink: Bonus Action, single use. Gain Psionic Weakening until Long Rest and replace other elixir effects.
fields.Psionic Weakening: Disadvantage on Constitution, Intelligence and Wisdom saving throws.
fields.Psionic Enrichment: After you use an Illithid power, gain Advantage on all attacks for 3 rounds.
fields.Crafting: Combine Sublimate of Tongue of Madness with any Essence.
fields.Base value: 30 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay and acquisition details with pinned source evidence.
